Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XVI OF 1999
INDUSTRIAL
RELATIONS (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
ORDINANCE XVI OF 1999
An Ordinance further to amend the Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 24th September, 1999].
F.No.2(1)/99-Pub., dated
24-9-1999.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Industrial Relations
(Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1999.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 1 Ordinance XXIII OF 1969

ORDINANCE XVI OF 1999
INDUSTRIAL
RELATIONS (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
ORDINANCE XVI OF 1999
An Ordinance further to amend the Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 24th September, 1999].
F.No.2(1)/99-Pub., dated
24-9-1999.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 1,
Ordinance XXIII of 1969.--In the Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969
(XXIII of 1969), in section 1, in subsection (3),--
(a) in clause (h) for the
full-stop at the end the semi-colon and word ";or" shall be
substituted; and
(b) after clause (h) amended as
aforesaid the following new clause shall be added, namely:--
"(i) by the Karachi Electric
Supply Corporation.".
